rep.partial_message: Shrug as high as you can, then lower fully.

checks.label: Arms bending
checks.message: Keep your arms straight and lift with your traps.

checks.label: Body swinging
checks.message: Don't sway or rock. Lift straight up and straight down.

camera.title: Face the camera
steps: Prop your phone or laptop 2.5 to 3 m away at chest height, with you facing it.
Stand far enough back that both hands stay in frame at the top of every rep.
Light the room from the front or above. A bright window behind you makes the camera lose your outline.
Wear fitted clothing so your shoulders and elbows are visible.
camera.note: Stand facing the camera with your ears and both shoulders in frame. The heavier the load, the smaller the movement, so the rep threshold is deliberately low.

guidance.accuracy: Free-weight lifts are the best case for a single camera: the joints that matter are visible and move in a plane the camera can see. Treat the feedback as a second pair of eyes, not a coach: a camera in 2D cannot see rotation or depth, and a lifter in the wrong clothes or light will confuse it.
